## DESeq GSE67333

Loading Libraries and Data

```{r}
# Loading libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)

# Loading data
load(file='/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata')

isoform_counts_GSE67333 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE67333")

gene_counts_GSE67333 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(isoform_counts_GSE67333)
```

Separating Metadata

```{r}
# Extracting sample ID
sample_metadata_GSE67333 <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(gene_counts_GSE67333)
)

# Making a new Condition column (Alzheimer or Control)
sample_metadata_GSE67333 <- sample_metadata_GSE67333 |>
  mutate(Condition = case_when(
    as.numeric(sub("GSM", "", Sample)) <= 1644999 ~ "Alzheimer",
    as.numeric(sub("GSM", "", Sample)) > 1644999 ~ "Control"
  ))

# Converting Condition into a factor
sample_metadata_GSE67333$Condition <- factor(
  sample_metadata_GSE67333$Condition,
  levels = c("Control", "Alzheimer")
)

# Naming the rows according to sample ID
rownames(sample_metadata_GSE67333) <- sample_metadata_GSE67333$Sample
```

Running DESeq

```{r}
# Creating DESeq dataset
dds_GSE67333 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = gene_counts_GSE67333,
  colData = sample_metadata_GSE67333,
  design = ~ Condition
)

# Running differential expression analysis
dds_GSE67333 <- DESeq(dds_GSE67333)

# Extracting Alzheimer vs Control results
res_GSE67333 <- results(
  dds_GSE67333,
  contrast = c("Condition", "Alzheimer", "Control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)

# Counting significant genes
n_sig_GSE67333 <- sum(
  res_GSE67333$padj < 0.05,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Counting upregulated genes
n_up_GSE67333 <- sum(
  res_GSE67333$padj < 0.05 &
  res_GSE67333$log2FoldChange > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Counting downregulated genes
n_down_GSE67333 <- sum(
  res_GSE67333$padj < 0.05 &
  res_GSE67333$log2FoldChange < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Displaying summary of results
cat(
  summary(res_GSE67333, alpha = 0.05),
  "\nNumber of Significant Genes:", n_sig_GSE67333,
  "\nNumber of Upregulated Genes:", n_up_GSE67333,
  "\nNumber of Downregulated Genes:", n_down_GSE67333,
  "\n"
)
```

Saving Results

```{r}
# Creating folder for results
out_dir_GSE67333 <- file.path("results", "DESeq2GSE67333")

dir.create(
  out_dir_GSE67333,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Converting results into a data frame
res_df_GSE67333 <- as.data.frame(res_GSE67333)

res_df_GSE67333$gene_id <- rownames(res_df_GSE67333)

# Saving all results
write.csv(
  res_df_GSE67333,
  file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DESeq2_all_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Filtering and saving significant genes
sig_genes_GSE67333 <- res_df_GSE67333 |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

write.csv(
  sig_genes_GSE67333,
  file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DESeq2_significant_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

Dispersion Estimation Plot

```{r}
# Plotting dispersion estimates
plotDispEsts(dds_GSE67333)
```

MA Plot

```{r}
# Plotting mean expression against log2 fold change
# Plotting mean expression against log2 fold change
plotMA(
  res_GSE67333,
  alpha = 0.05,
  main = "GSE67333 - Alzheimer vs Control"
)
```

Volcano Plot

```{r}
# Classifying genes by significance and fold change
volcano_GSE67333 <- as.data.frame(res_GSE67333) |>
  mutate(
    Regulation = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Upregulated",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not highlighted"
    )
  )

# Volcano Plot
ggplot(
  volcano_GSE67333,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj),
      color = Regulation)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Upregulated" = "forestgreen",
      "Downregulated" = "orange",
      "Not highlighted" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE67333 - Alzheimer vs Control",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-6, 6), ylim = c(0, 7)) +
  theme_minimal()
```
